answer: Honeypot canaries resist sybil grading: the system secretly injects tasks whose verdict it already knows, plausible fabrications seeded into the grading tide, indistinguishable from real work. A grader approving a planted bad answer flags itself and is slashed, so a ring cross-approving its own fakes cannot tell a honeypot from real work and trips the trap with probability rising each epoch. An honest grader, anchored to real checking, passes every canary. The more fakes a ring grades toward a summit of influence, the more honeypots it must survive.
